literature.lead_zh: 近期研究揭示了狂犬病病毒在疫苗开发、病毒传播机制和宿主适应性方面的多个重要发现。
key_findings_zh: 表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯(EGCG)能有效抑制狂犬病病毒的感染,为开发新的抗病毒策略提供了可能。
狂犬病病毒通过不完全自噬和铁代谢重编程稳定RGS4,以抑制铁死亡,这为理解病毒的致病机制提供了新视角。
通过反向疫苗学设计的多表位疫苗在体外模拟实验中表现出良好的免疫激活效果,为狂犬病疫苗的开发提供了新思路。
在马拉维,狂犬病暴露后预防的获取途径繁琐且冗长,需要简化流程以减少死亡人数。
狂犬病病毒的传播动态和宿主适应性与其糖蛋白介导的神经受体功能操纵密切相关,这为疫苗设计提供了新靶点。
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 研究发现表明,通过多种机制,狂犬病病毒能够有效抑制宿主的免疫反应,这可能增加病毒的传播风险。
literature.caveats_zh: 尽管研究提供了新的见解,但实际应用中仍需进一步验证。
literature.lead_en: Recent studies have uncovered several important findings on rabies virus, including vaccine development, viral transmission mechanisms, and host adaptation.
key_findings_en: Epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) effectively inhibits rabies virus infection, suggesting potential new antiviral strategies.
Rabies virus stabilizes RGS4 through incomplete autophagy and iron metabolic reprogramming, which inhibits ferroptosis, providing new insights into viral pathogenesis.
A multi-epitope vaccine designed using reverse vaccinology shows promising immune activation in vitro, offering new avenues for vaccine development.
In Malawi, the rabies post-exposure prophylaxis pathway is complex and lengthy, necessitating simplification to reduce mortality.
Rabies virus transmission dynamics and host adaptation are linked to glycoprotein-mediated manipulation of neuroreceptor function, providing new targets for vaccine design.
literature.trend_or_risk_en: Studies indicate that rabies virus can effectively suppress host immune responses through multiple mechanisms, potentially increasing transmission risks.
literature.caveats_en: While these findings provide new insights, further validation is needed in practical applications.
literature.brief_en: Recent research on rabies virus has uncovered new mechanisms of viral pathogenesis and potential vaccine targets, emphasizing the need for further validation and application.

Epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) effectively inhibits rabies virus infection, suggesting potential new antiviral strategies. Rabies virus stabilizes RGS4 through incomplete autophagy and iron metabolic reprogramming, which inhibits ferroptosis, providing new insights into viral pathogenesis. news.headline_zh: 狂犬病病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期狂犬病病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: East Meadow 的一只被困野猫检测出 狂犬病 呈阳性,这是拿骚县今年第二例该病。拿骚县卫生部门报告了该病例,并强调避免与野生动物接触并确保宠物了解最新 狂犬病 疫苗接种 的重要性。 [news-07401f323358e949]
不列颠哥伦比亚省和魁北克省的公共卫生官员正在处理与人或家养宠物接触过的野生动物中的 狂犬病。温哥华的一只带有 狂犬病 的臭鼬已经咬伤了一小部分人,魁北克浣熊体内有一种带有 狂犬病 的 狂犬病 病毒,它已将病毒传播给了三只猫。 [news-9d67a3186f6a89c1]
450 人在食用由疑似患有狂犬病的奶牛的牛奶制成的 Charanamrit 后,接受了抗 狂犬病 疫苗接种 治疗;该事件正在调查中。 [news-c38468d156bd7f21]
两只野生动物的 狂犬病 检测呈阳性,史密斯菲尔德的一只狗在接触 狂犬病 后接受了检测。卫生部门确认了这些病例,并向公众提供了预防建议。 [news-a0fd0a5459304948]
在温哥华市中心捕获的一只臭鼬的 狂犬病 检测结果呈阳性。这是温哥华海岸卫生局(VCH)报告的确诊病例。 [news-ab3a54e2845d26cd]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Rabies virus news developments.
key_findings_en: A trapped feral cat in East Meadow tested positive for rabies, marking the second case of the disease in Nassau County this year. The Nassau County Health Department reported the case and emphasized the importance of avoiding contact with wild and feral animals and ensuring pets are up to date on rabies vaccinations. [news-07401f323358e949]
Public health officials in British Columbia and Quebec are dealing with rabies in wild animals that have come into contact with people or domestic pets. [news-9d67a3186f6a89c1]
450 people received anti-rabies vaccinations after consuming charanamrit made from milk of a suspected rabid cow; the event is under investigation. [news-c38468d156bd7f21]

Two wild animals tested positive for rabies, with a dog in Smithfield receiving post-exposure treatment. The Health Department confirmed these cases and provided prevention tips to the public. [news-a0fd0a5459304948]
A skunk captured in downtown Vancouver has tested positive for rabies. This is a confirmed case reported by Vancouver Coastal Health (VCH). [news-ab3a54e2845d26cd]

papers.title: Epigallocatechin gallate inhibits rabies virus glycoprotein‐mediated infection in vitro
papers.abstract: Rabies is one of the most lethal zoonotic disease and causes approximately 60,000 human deaths annually. The high cost of immunoglobulin prophylaxis and the need for cold chain maintenance highlight the need for accessible antiviral strategies, particularly in resource-limited settings. Epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG), the major polyphenolic compound of Camellia sinensis, has broad-spectrum antiviral activity. We therefore investigated its activity against Rabies virus (RABV). Because RABV requires BSL-3 containment, we first used a recombinant Vesicular Stomatitis Virus pseudotyped with RABV glycoprotein (pRABV) as a surrogate. EGCG inhibited pRABV infection in a concentration-dependent manner, with an EC50 of approximately 0.15 μg/mL and a selectivity index > 551.72. Time-of-addition, attachment, and entry assays showed that EGCG reduced pRABV infectivity when present during viral adsorption or after pre-incubation with viral particles, whereas no inhibition was observed when cells were treated before infection or after virus internalization. Viral infectivity remained almost completely abolished in a virucidal assay even after EGCG was diluted below its effective antiviral concentration, supporting a direct and irreversible effect on viral particles. EGCG activity was further confirmed using authentic RABV and disease-relevant cell types, including myotubes and neurons. Overall, these findings indicate that EGCG inhibits early stages of the RABV replication cycle, primarily by interfering with viral attachment and directly affecting viral particles. Further studies are needed to define the molecular basis of this interaction and assess the therapeutic potential of EGCG against RABV.

papers.title: Overexpression of nucleoprotein downregulates Rabies virus mRNA transcription
papers.abstract: Rabies is a fatal zoonotic disease of the central nervous system of mammals caused by Rabies lyssavirus (RABV), a member of the order Mononegavirales. Its single-stranded negative-sense RNA genome encodes five structural proteins: nucleoprotein (N), phosphoprotein (P), matrix protein (M), glycoprotein (G), and large protein (L). N plays a pivotal role in nucleocapsid assembly, regulation of viral transcription and replication, and the formation of Negri bodies, cytoplasmic viral factories essential for viral replication. Consequently, overexpression of N may disrupt RABV replicative dynamics, offering insight into the mechanisms governing its replication cycle while identifying potential targets for antiviral intervention. This study evaluated the effects of transient expression of RABV N mRNA on viral replication using a plasmid-based expression system in BHK-21 cells. BHK-21 cells were transfected with the pcDNA3.1(+)/C-DYK plasmid containing the N gene from the Challenge Virus Standard (CVS-11) strain of RABV. Viral mRNA transcription and total genomic viral load were quantified using absolute RT-qPCR. Overexpression n N mRNA led to a downward trend in viral mRNA transcription levels, although total viral genomic load remained largely unaffected. These findings provide further insight into the regulatory function of N during RABV replication and suggest that modulating N expression influences viral transcriptional dynamics.
papers.journal: Brazilian Journal of Animal and Environmental Research

Overexpression n N mRNA led to a downward trend in viral mRNA transcription levels, although total viral genomic load remained largely unaffected. papers.abstract_zh: 狂犬病 是一种致命的哺乳动物中枢神经系统疾病,由单股病毒目成员 狂犬病 狂犬病病毒 (RABV) 引起。其单链负义RNA 基因组编码五种结构蛋白:核蛋白(N)、磷蛋白(P)、基质蛋白(M)、糖蛋白(G)和大蛋白(L)。N 在核衣壳组装、病毒转录和复制的调节以及内格里体(病毒复制所必需的细胞质病毒工厂)的形成中发挥着关键作用。因此,N 的过度表达可能会破坏 RABV 的复制动态,从而深入了解控制其复制周期的机制,同时确定 抗病毒药物 干预的潜在目标。本研究使用基于质粒的表达系统在 BHK-21 细胞中评估了 RABV N mRNA 瞬时表达对病毒复制的影响。BHK-21细胞用含有来自RABV攻击病毒标准(CVS-11)株的N基因的pcDNA3.1(+)/C-DYK质粒转染。使用绝对 RT-qPCR 对病毒 mRNA 转录和总基因组病毒载量进行定量。nN mRNA 过度表达导致病毒 mRNA 转录水平呈下降趋势,但病毒基因组总载量基本不受影响。这些发现进一步深入了解了 N 在 RABV 复制过程中的调节功能,并表明调节 N 表达会影响病毒转录动力学。

papers.title: Engineering a low cytotoxicity recombinant rabies virus neurotracer via N-gene recoding
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Viral-vector-based tracers have proven invaluable for mapping neural circuits. Rabies virus (RV)-based retrograde trans-monosynaptic tracers have been widely used for depicting the input neural circuit of targeted neuronal populations. However, the cytotoxicity of the RV tracer limits its application. Here, we employed the synthetic attenuated virus engineering technology to recode the N gene of the RV SAD-B19 strain by codon pair deoptimization to generate attenuated RV tracers. The characteristics of the recoded RV tracers were tested both in vitro and in vivo . The full-length recoded N gene abolished viral rescue, whereas the partial recoded N gene supported successful viral recovery. Compared to its parent, the recoded RV trans-monosynaptic tracer exhibited lower cytotoxicity and labeled more input neurons. It can also robustly express proteins to visualize the neuronal morphology and manipulate the neural circuit activity. Collectively, our work generated a new retrograde trans-monosynaptic tool, which complements existing neural circuit tracers. IMPORTANCE Viral vectors play an important role across multiple fields in biomedicine. In the neuroscience community, rabies virus (RV)-based retrograde trans-monosynaptic tracers have been widely used to map the input neural circuits of targeted neuronal populations. However, the inherent cytotoxicity of RV-based tracers limits their broader application. In this study, we utilized synthetic attenuated virus engineering technology to recode the RV N gene, generating an attenuated neurotracer that will significantly benefit future neuroscience research.

papers.title: The Barrier effect of high-affinity IgM neutralizing antibodies provides enhanced blockage against rabies virus transport and infection
papers.abstract: Abstract Antibody-mediated protection plays a crucial role in post-exposure prophylaxis against rabies infection, while engineered antibodies with novel functional mechanisms offer enhanced preventive efficacy. In this study, we investigated the in vitro and in vivo activities as well as the protective efficacy of CR4008 antibodies with different conformational structures. We demonstrated that under passive immunization with antibodies of equivalent neutralizing efficacy, IgM antibodies exhibited superior protection against viral challenge compared with other antibodies. The underlying mechanism involves antibody barriers along the sarcolemma by IgM antibodies, which effectively inhibits viral transport in the infectious microenvironment within muscle tissues. Following high-affinity binding and neutralizing, barrier antibodies prevent the virus from retrogradely spreading to the central nervous system and prevent rabies development. Our study suggests that, in addition to neutralizing activity, effective inhibition of viral spread caused by the unique distribution of IgM antibodies in exposed tissues is critical and valuable for passive immunization against rabies infection.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 抗体介导的保护在 暴露后预防 对抗 狂犬病 感染中发挥着至关重要的作用,而具有新颖功能机制的工程抗体可增强预防功效。在本研究中,我们研究了不同构象结构的CR4008抗体的体外和体内活性以及保护功效。我们证明,在使用具有同等中和功效的抗体进行被动免疫的情况下,与其他抗体相比,IgM 抗体对病毒攻击表现出优异的保护作用。其潜在机制涉及 IgM 抗体沿肌膜形成的抗体屏障,可有效抑制肌肉组织内感染性微环境中的病毒转运。在高亲和力结合和中和之后,屏障抗体可防止病毒逆行传播至中枢神经系统并阻止 狂犬病 的发展。我们的研究表明,除了中和活性外,暴露组织中 IgM 抗体的独特分布所引起的病毒传播的有效抑制对于针对 狂犬病 感染的被动免疫至关重要且有价值。

papers.title: SIRT5 Attenuates Traumatic Brain Injury by Preserving OPA1-Mediated Mitochondrial Fusion and Limiting Oxidative Stress.
papers.abstract: Aims: Mitochondrial dysfunction and oxidative stress are central pathological drivers of disease progression following traumatic brain injury (TBI). Sirtuin 5 (SIRT5), a predominantly mitochondrial NAD + -dependent deacylase, plays critical roles in mitochondrial quality control, redox homeostasis, and metabolic regulation. This study aims to define the upstream regulatory machinery controlling SIRT5 stability and to identify the downstream pathway linking SIRT5 to mitochondrial remodeling after TBI. Results: In this study, we demonstrated that TBI promotes neuronal SIRT5 protein degradation via a synergistic regulatory mechanism involving USP7 and TRIM21. Using neuron-specific Sirt5 conditional knockout mice, we found that SIRT5 deficiency exacerbates TBI-induced mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative damage, cerebral edema, and neurological deficits. SIRT5 regulates OPA1 expression through a MEF2A-dependent mechanism, thereby preserving mitochondrial structure and function and alleviating oxidative injury. The protective effects of neuronal SIRT5 overexpression were abolished in mice lacking Opa1 specifically in neurons, confirming that OPA1 is a critical downstream effector of SIRT5-mediated neuroprotection. Finally, rabies virus glycoprotein (RVG)-conjugated extracellular vesicles loaded with SIRT5 mRNA demonstrated both efficacy and safety in preclinical TBI models. Innovation: This study identifies the USP7/TRIM21-SIRT5-MEF2A-OPA1 axis as a novel regulatory cascade that governs the transition between adaptive and maladaptive mitochondrial remodeling after TBI, a concept with broad implications for acute brain injury and neurodegeneration. Conclusion: This study defines the USP7/TRIM21-SIRT5-MEF2A-OPA1 axis as a novel regulatory cascade that controls mitochondrial remodeling after TBI. SIRT5 acts through a MEF2A-dependent mechanism to maintain OPA1 expression and mitochondrial fusion, and its transient restoration via RVG-EV delivery of SIRT5 mRNA is a promising therapeutic strategy.

elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用神经元特异性 Sirt5 条件敲除小鼠来研究 SIRT5 缺陷对 TBI 的影响。它还使用装载有 SIRT5 mRNA 的 狂犬病病毒 糖蛋白 (RVG) 缀合的细胞外囊泡在临床前 TBI 模型中递送该蛋白质。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,针对 USP7/TRIM21-SIRT5-MEF2A-OPA1 轴可以为减轻 TBI 诱导的线粒体功能障碍和氧化应激提供新的治疗策略,这对于急性脑损伤和神经退行性疾病至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于临床前模型,不包括人体数据。证据是温和的,因为它是基于小鼠的实验结果,这可能无法完全转化为人类的情况。

papers.title: Serological response to field rabies vaccination in owned dogs in the immune belt of Peninsular Malaysia
papers.abstract: Rabies vaccination is conducted along the northern border of Peninsular Malaysia, but paired field serological data are limited. We analysed routine programme data from 154 owned dogs sampled immediately before vaccination and 30-83 days later (median, 43 days). Rabies virus-neutralising antibody levels were measured using the fluorescent antibody virus neutralisation test. Paired levels in IU/mL were compared using the Wilcoxon signed-rank test, and benchmark proportions were compared using the exact McNemar test. The proportion with levels ≥ 0.5 IU/mL increased from 72.7% (112/154; 95% confidence interval [CI], 65.2-79.1%) to 98.1% (151/154; 95% CI, 94.4-99.3%; p < 0.001). Three dogs remained below the benchmark. Median levels increased from 1.98 IU/mL (interquartile range [IQR], 0.38-5.92) to 13.5 IU/mL (IQR, 4.5-13.5); the median paired increase was 5.45 IU/mL (bootstrap 95% CI, 3.31-7.25; p < 0.001). Levels increased in 128 dogs, were unchanged in 19 and decreased in seven. Eighty follow-up values equalled the dataset maximum of 13.5 IU/mL, suggesting possible upper-end censoring. Vaccination history identified 99 previously vaccinated dogs and seven recorded as receiving their first vaccination, limiting comparison of these groups. Nearly all dogs retained at follow-up met the serological benchmark. Convenience sampling, incomplete follow-up and uncertain measurement limits restrict inference to this cohort and preclude estimates of population immunity or clinical effectiveness.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the serological response to rabies vaccination in owned dogs in Peninsular Malaysia. The research aimed to address the lack of paired field serological data in this region. A total of 154 dogs were sampled before and after vaccination, with antibody levels measured using the fluorescent antibody virus neutralisation test. The results showed a significant increase in the proportion of dogs with antibody levels ≥ 0.5 IU/mL, from 72.7% to 98.1%, with a median increase of 5.45 IU/mL. papers.title: Virus transmission required for maintenance and host adaptation mirrors neurophysiological differences in rabies-derived peptides
papers.abstract: Pathogen adaptations to new hosts are central to the disease ecology of cross-species transmission and host switching of viruses. The rabies virus is a model for adaptations to different hosts as it induces behavioral changes that facilitate transmission, while being maintained in distinct species-specific cycles of infection. Here, we demonstrate that the rabies virus requires distinct transmission dynamics in two hosts with different ecologies to establish maintenance, using agent-based modeling, analyses of virus glycoprotein-mediated manipulation of neuroreceptor function, and phylogenetic analysis. Epidemiological models suggest that rabies virus variants adapted to arctic foxes, which sustain rabies virus at very low host densities, require a higher probability of transmission than viruses adapted to raccoons. Using in vitro electrophysiology, we demonstrate that the rabies glycoprotein-derived peptides from arctic fox rabies variants are more potent antagonists of alpha7 nicotinic acetylcholine receptors. These findings suggest a possible functional basis for the behavioral modifications that drive enzootic rabies transmission in the context of host ecology. In addition, a large proportion of residues that may drive rabies virus adaptation to raccoons and arctic foxes are found within this neurotoxin-like region. Furthermore, a residue in the neurotoxin-like region of the mature rabies virus glycoprotein (residue 183) has been associated with pathogenicity, host switching, and disease ecology in previous studies. We propose the hypothesis that rabies virus transmission dynamics adapt to the ecology and physiology of novel hosts through the selection of glycoproteins that elicit specific degrees of behavioral modification and transmission probability.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解 狂犬病病毒 如何适应不同的 宿主,重点关注促进 传播 和维持不同物种特异性感染周期的行为变化。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用基于代理的建模、体外电生理学和系统发育分析来检查北极狐和浣熊的 狂犬病病毒 变异。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用基于代理的建模、体外电生理学来分析 狂犬病 糖蛋白衍生肽,并采用系统发育分析来评估病毒对不同 宿主 的适应。
elements_zh.main_results: 流行病学模型表明,适应北极狐的 狂犬病病毒 变体比适应浣熊的 传播 变体需要更高的 传播 概率。体外电生理学表明,来自北极狐 狂犬病 变体的 狂犬病 糖蛋白衍生肽是 α7 烟碱乙酰胆碱受体更有效的拮抗剂。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,在 宿主 生态背景下,驱动地方性 狂犬病 传播 的行为改变具有功能基础,狂犬病病毒 糖蛋白的神经毒素样区域中的特定残基发挥着至关重要的作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果提供了对 狂犬病病毒 适应不同 宿主 的机制的见解,这可以为 狂犬病 的 监测、诊断 和 治疗 策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究对建模和体外电生理学的依赖限制了研究结果的普遍性。然而,证据表明 狂犬病病毒 糖蛋白神经毒素样区域中特定残基的作用具有很高的可信度。

papers.abstract_zh: 病原体对新 宿主 的适应是跨物种 传播 和 宿主 病毒转换的疾病生态学的核心。狂犬病病毒 是适应不同 宿主 的模型,因为它诱导有利于 传播 的行为变化,同时保持在不同物种特定的感染周期中。在这里,我们证明了 狂犬病病毒 需要两个具有不同生态的 宿主 具有不同的 传播 动力学来建立维护,使用基于代理的建模、病毒糖蛋白介导的神经受体功能操纵分析和系统发育分析。流行病学模型表明,适应北极狐的 狂犬病病毒 变种以非常低的 宿主 密度维持 狂犬病病毒,与适应浣熊的病毒相比,需要更高的 传播 概率。利用体外电生理学,我们证明来自北极狐 狂犬病 变体的 狂犬病 糖蛋白衍生肽是 α7 烟碱乙酰胆碱受体的更有效的拮抗剂。这些发现表明,在 宿主 生态背景下,驱动地方性 狂犬病 传播 的行为改变可能具有功能基础。此外,在这个神经毒素样区域内发现了很大一部分可能驱动 狂犬病病毒 适应浣熊和北极狐的残基。此外,在之前的研究中,成熟 狂犬病病毒 糖蛋白的神经毒素样区域(残基 183)中的残基已与致病性、宿主 转换和疾病生态学相关。我们提出这样的假设:狂犬病病毒 传播 动力学通过选择引起特定程度的行为修饰和 传播 概率的糖蛋白来适应新型 宿主 的生态学和生理学。

papers.title: Lyssavirus matrix protein stabilizes RGS4 to suppress ferroptosis via incomplete autophagy and iron metabolic reprogramming
papers.abstract: Rabies virus (RABV), the prototypical lyssavirus, suppresses neuronal ferroptosis through lipid droplet (LD) biogenesis, which is a critical immune evasion strategy we previously identified. However, the mechanistic link between LD formation and ferroptosis regulation during RABV infection remains poorly defined. Here, we report that RABV upregulate Regulator of G Protein Signaling 4 (RGS4), a ferroptosis-associated regulator, and this induction is strictly dependent on triglyceride synthesis and subsequent LD formation. Functionally, genetic or pharmacological inhibition of RGS4 elevates ferroptosis susceptibility, thereby restricting viral replication. Mechanistically, RGS4 depletion reduces HERC2, impairing the assembly of branched K48/K63 ubiquitin chains on NCOA4, which is essential for its proteasomal degradation, thereby enhancing NCOA4 stability. Stabilized NCOA4 promotes ferritinophagy, leading to degradation of ferritin heavy chain (FTH) and ultimately inducing ferroptosis. Critically, we identified that the lyssavirus matrix (M) protein directly counteracts this pathway: M protein inhibits RGS4 degradation via the Cys/N-degron system through incomplete autophagy, stabilizing RGS4 to maintain HERC2 expression, promote NCOA4 ubiquitination, and attenuate ferritinophagy. This mechanism reduces ferroptosis susceptibility and enables viral replication. Our findings unveil a novel lyssavirus-specific regulatory axis, RGS4-HERC2-NCOA4-FTH, that modulates ferroptosis, highlighting the critical role of ferroptosis in lyssavirus infection and pathogenesis.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how rabies virus (RABV) suppresses neuronal ferroptosis through lipid droplet (LD) biogenesis, a previously identified immune evasion strategy. The research reveals that RABV upregulates RGS4, a ferroptosis-associated regulator, which is dependent on triglyceride synthesis and LD formation. Mechanistically, RGS4 depletion reduces HERC2, impairing NCOA4 ubiquitination and enhancing its stability. Stabilized NCOA4 promotes ferritinophagy, leading to ferroptosis. The lyssavirus matrix (M) protein counteracts this pathway by inhibiting RGS4 degradation via the Cys/N-degron system through incomplete autophagy, thereby stabilizing RGS4 and attenuating ferritinophagy. This mechanism reduces ferroptosis susceptibility and supports viral replication. The findings highlight a novel regulatory axis, RGS4-HERC2-NCOA4-FTH, that modulates ferroptosis in rabies virus infection, emphasizing the critical role of ferroptosis in the pathogenesis of rabies. The study provides insights into the molecular mechanisms of rabies virus evasion of host cell death pathways, which could inform future research on antiviral strategies and therapeutic interventions.

papers.title: In silico multi-epitope vaccine design against Irkut virus using immunoinformatic and reverse vaccinology
papers.abstract: Irkut virus (IRKV) is a member of genus Lyssavirus, which leads to fatal encephalitis in humans and is primarily found in bats and dogs that transmit the virus to humans via bites/saliva. Most cases have been reported in Russia and in Siberia and recently in China. Whole genome sequencing has shown a number of codon changes in antigenic sites common to the Rabies vaccine reducing cross-protection, which makes IRKV a serious public health threat because of its high fatality. In this study, a multi-epitope vaccine against the IRKV glycoprotein was designed via reverse vaccinology approach. Seven B-cell, seven MHC-I, and seven MHC-II epitopes were selected. These epitopes have predicted HLA binding affinity and are non-allergen, and 12 out of 21 epitopes were fully conserved across the three circulating IRKV strains, whereas remaining nine carried out one or two substitutions. The chosen epitopes covered 99.57% of the world population. The final construct which included an adjuvant (EAAAK), epitopes, and a 6xHis tag was predicted to be highly antigenic (VaxiJen score 0.8112) and non-allergenic (AllerTop), showing no sequence mimicry with human proteins by BLASTp screening. The physicochemical analysis suggested that the construct was basic, hydrophilic, and stable (aliphatic index 68.11, instability index 37.5, pI 10.43, GRAVY -0.323). The 3D structure built using SWISS-MODEL and Phyre2 and refined by GalaxyRefine depicts that 95.1% of residues lie in the favored regions of the Ramachandran plot. The structural superposition with the native viral glycoprotein showed that the native fold was well preserved (core RMSD ≈ 2.4 Å). The molecular docking with TLR4 (minimum energy -1086.3) and normal mode analysis further suggested the stability of the receptor binding and structural integrity. C-ImmSim immune simulation with two doses (prime-boost) showed an enhanced secondary immune response following boost dose, manifested by a higher level of IgM, IgG, CD4+ T-helper cells activation, and cytokine production. The immune activation profile predicted was generally similar to that for the full-length G protein, and the CD8+ T-cell response was similar between the two antigens in the one simulation run. These results indicate that the multi-epitope construct vaccine is structurally stable and immunologically promising and can be used as a vaccine candidate for further experimental evaluation against Irkut virus.

In silico multi-epitope vaccine design against Irkut virus using immunoinformatic and reverse vaccinology.
source_records.abstract: Irkut virus (IRKV) is a member of genus Lyssavirus, which leads to fatal encephalitis in humans and is primarily found in bats and dogs that transmit the virus to humans via bites/saliva. Most cases have been reported in Russia and in Siberia and recently in China. Whole genome sequencing has shown a number of codon changes in antigenic sites common to the Rabies vaccine reducing cross-protection, which makes IRKV a serious public health threat because of its high fatality. In this study, a multi-epitope vaccine against the IRKV glycoprotein was designed via reverse vaccinology approach. Seven B-cell, seven MHC-I, and seven MHC-II epitopes were selected. These epitopes have predicted HLA binding affinity and are non-allergen, and 12 out of 21 epitopes were fully conserved across the three circulating IRKV strains, whereas remaining nine carried out one or two substitutions. The chosen epitopes covered 99.57% of the world population. The final construct which included an adjuvant (EAAAK), epitopes, and a 6xHis tag was predicted to be highly antigenic (VaxiJen score 0.8112) and non-allergenic (AllerTop), showing no sequence mimicry with human proteins by BLASTp screening. The physicochemical analysis suggested that the construct was basic, hydrophilic, and stable (aliphatic index 68.11, instability index 37.5, pI 10.43, GRAVY -0.323). The 3D structure built using SWISS-MODEL and Phyre2 and refined by GalaxyRefine depicts that 95.1% of residues lie in the favored regions of the Ramachandran plot. The structural superposition with the native viral glycoprotein showed that the native fold was well preserved (core RMSD ≈ 2.4 Å). The molecular docking with TLR4 (minimum energy -1086.3) and normal mode analysis further suggested the stability of the receptor binding and structural integrity. C-ImmSim immune simulation with two doses (prime-boost) showed an enhanced secondary immune response following boost dose, manifested by a higher level of IgM, IgG, CD4+ T-helper cells activation, and cytokine production. The immune activation profile predicted was generally similar to that for the full-length G protein, and the CD8+ T-cell response was similar between the two antigens in the one simulation run. These results indicate that the multi-epitope construct vaccine is structurally stable and immunologically promising and can be used as a vaccine candidate for further experimental evaluation against Irkut virus.

papers.abstract_zh: 伊尔库特病毒 (IRKV) 是狂犬病病毒属的成员,可导致人类致命性脑炎,主要存在于蝙蝠和狗中,它们通过叮咬/唾液将病毒传播给人类。大多数病例是在俄罗斯和西伯利亚以及最近在中国报告的。整个 基因组 测序显示,狂犬病 疫苗 共有的抗原位点发生了许多密码子变化,减少了交叉保护,这使得 IRKV 由于其高致死率而成为严重的公共卫生威胁。在这项研究中,通过反向疫苗学方法设计了针对 IRKV 糖蛋白的多表位 疫苗。选择七个 B 细胞、七个 MHC-I 和七个 MHC-II 表位。这些表位预测了 HLA 结合亲和力,并且不是过敏原,21 个表位中有 12 个在三种循环 IRKV 毒株中完全保守,而其余 9 个进行了一到两次替换。所选表位覆盖了世界人口的99.57%。最终的构建体包括佐剂 (EAAAK)、表位和 6xHis 标签,预计具有高抗原性(VaxiJen 评分 0.8112)和非过敏性 (AllerTop),通过 BLASTp 筛选显示与人类蛋白质没有序列模拟。理化分析表明该构建体是碱性、亲水性和稳定的(脂肪族指数68.11,不稳定指数37.5,pI 10.43,GRAVY -0.323)。使用 SWISS-MODEL 和 Phyre2 构建并由 GalaxyRefine 细化的 3D 结构描述了 95.1% 的残基位于 Ramachandran 图的有利区域。与天然病毒糖蛋白的结构叠加表明,天然折叠得到了很好的保存(核心 RMSD ≈ 2.4 Å)。与TLR4(最小能量-1086.3)的分子对接和正常模式分析进一步表明受体结合的稳定性和结构完整性。两次剂量(初免-加强)的 C-ImmSim 免疫模拟显示,加强剂量后二次 免疫应答 增强,表现为更高水平的 IgM、IgG、CD4+ T 辅助细胞激活和细胞因子产生。预测的免疫激活谱通常与全长 G 蛋白的免疫激活谱相似,并且在一次模拟运行中,两种抗原之间的 CD8+ T 细胞反应相似。这些结果表明,多表位构建体 疫苗 结构稳定,免疫学前景良好,可用作 疫苗 候选物,用于进一步针对伊尔库特病毒的实验评估。

papers.title: Operational and intercultural challenges of mass rabies vaccination in the Maxakali Indigenous Territory
papers.abstract: Rabies is a fatal but preventable zoonosis that disproportionately affects vulnerable populations with limited access to healthcare. Mass vaccination of dogs and cats is the main control strategy, but evidence from Indigenous and remote settings is scarce. The aim of this study was to examine the operational, epidemiological, and sociocultural challenges associated with a mass rabies vaccination campaign implemented in response to a human rabies outbreak in Indigenous communities in Brazil. This qualitative descriptive study with an operational research component was conducted in Maxakali villages, Minas Gerais, after a rabies outbreak (April–May 2022). Data were collected through document analysis, field diaries, and direct observation, and analyzed using thematic content analysis guided by a One Health framework. Epidemiological indicators on vaccinated animals were also assessed. A total of 553 animals were vaccinated, including 427 dogs (77.2%) and 126 cats (22.8%), with heterogeneous distribution across villages. Although high operational coverage was achieved, the absence of reliable population denominators limited precise estimation of vaccination coverage. Major challenges included geographical barriers, difficulties in maintaining the cold chain, limited availability of trained personnel, and scarcity of animal restraint equipment. Sociocultural factors, such as language barriers and initial resistance to vaccination, influenced community adherence, which improved through the involvement of Indigenous leaders and health agents. Poor animal health conditions and free-roaming behavior further complicated the campaign. Mass rabies vaccination in indigenous territories is feasible but requires context-specific strategies addressing logistics, intercultural communication, and animal management. Strengthening integrated surveillance and community-engaged approaches is essential to improve rabies control.

The aim of this study was to examine the operational, epidemiological, and sociocultural challenges associated with a mass rabies vaccination campaign implemented in response to a human rabies outbreak in Indigenous communities in Brazil. This qualitative descriptive study with an operational research component was conducted in Maxakali villages, Minas Gerais, after a rabies outbreak (April–May 2022). Data were collected through document analysis, field diaries, and direct observation, and analyzed using thematic content analysis guided by a One Health framework. Epidemiological indicators on vaccinated animals were also assessed. A total of 553 animals were vaccinated, including 427 dogs (77.2%) and 126 cats (22.8%), with heterogeneous distribution across villages. Although high operational coverage was achieved, the absence of reliable population denominators limited precise estimation of vaccination coverage. Major challenges included geographical barriers, difficulties in maintaining the cold chain, limited availability of trained personnel, and scarcity of animal restraint equipment. Sociocultural factors, such as language barriers and initial resistance to vaccination, influenced community adherence, which improved through the involvement of Indigenous leaders and health agents. Poor animal health conditions and free-roaming behavior further complicated the campaign. Mass rabies vaccination in indigenous territories is feasible but requires context-specific strategies addressing logistics, intercultural communication, and animal management. Strengthening integrated surveillance and community-engaged approaches is essential to improve rabies control.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the operational, epidemiological, and sociocultural challenges of implementing a mass rabies vaccination campaign in the Maxakali Indigenous Territory in Brazil following a human rabies outbreak. The qualitative descriptive study with an operational research component was conducted in April–May 2022, involving 553 animals, primarily dogs and cats, across the territory. Data were collected through document analysis, field diaries, and direct observation, and analyzed using thematic content analysis guided by a One Health framework. The main results identified geographical barriers, cold chain difficulties, limited trained personnel, and scarcity of animal restraint equipment as significant challenges. The study suggests that strengthening integrated surveillance and community-engaged approaches is essential for improving rabies control in Indigenous territories. However, the absence of reliable population denominators limited precise estimation of vaccination coverage, and the study's qualitative nature may affect the strength of its evidence.

papers.abstract_zh: 狂犬病 是一种致命但可预防的 人兽共患病,它对获得医疗保健机会有限的弱势群体造成了不成比例的影响。对狗和猫进行大规模 疫苗接种 是主要的控制策略,但来自土著和偏远地区的证据很少。本研究的目的是检查与巴西土著社区针对人类 狂犬病 暴发 实施的大规模 狂犬病 疫苗接种 运动相关的操作、流行病学和社会文化挑战。这项包含运筹学成分的定性描述性研究是在 狂犬病 暴发(2022 年 4 月至 5 月)之后在米纳斯吉拉斯州 Maxakali 村庄进行的。通过文档分析、实地日记和直接观察收集数据,并使用 One Health 框架指导下的主题内容分析进行分析。还评估了接种疫苗的动物的流行病学指标。共有 553 只动物接种了疫苗,其中狗 427 只(77.2%)和猫 126 只(22.8%),各村庄分布不均匀。尽管实现了较高的业务覆盖率,但由于缺乏可靠的人口分母,限制了 疫苗接种 覆盖率的精确估计。主要挑战包括地理障碍、冷链维护困难、训练有素的人员有限以及动物约束设备稀缺。语言障碍和对 疫苗接种 的最初抵制等社会文化因素影响了社区的依从性,而通过原住民领导人和卫生代理人的参与,社区依从性得到了改善。动物健康状况不佳和自由漫游行为使这场活动变得更加复杂。在土著地区进行大规模 狂犬病 疫苗接种 是可行的,但需要针对物流、跨文化交流和动物管理等具体情况制定策略。加强综合 监测 和社区参与方法对于改善 狂犬病 控制至关重要。

papers.title: Rabies surveillance in the United States during 2024
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Describe the epidemiologic landscape of rabies and rabies testing in the US during 2024. Methods Animal rabies testing results from approximately 130 public health, agriculture, and academic laboratories are collected by the US National Rabies Surveillance System (NRSS) each month. Data reported in 2024 were analyzed to examine temporal and geographic trends in animal rabies cases by rabies virus variant (RVV). Results In 2024, 3,834 cases of animal rabies were reported to the NRSS (4.2% of 90,343 samples submitted), representing a 2.0% increase from 2023. Of positive samples, 331 (8.6%) were domestic animals, and 3,503 (91.4%) were wildlife. The most commonly found rabid domestic animal was cats (243 positive [1.3% positivity]), and the most commonly found wildlife were bats (1,376 positive [5.7% positivity]) followed by raccoons (1,080 [10.1% positivity]). Two nonenzootic RVVs gained entry into the US in 2024. Four people died from rabies, including 2 who experienced bat exposures that were left untreated and 1 person whose case involved international travel. Conclusions The expansion of the historical range of enzootic RVVs can lead to substantial public health and animal health burden. Domestically acquired human rabies cases in 2024 underscore the need for continual public education on the risks of rabies exposures to ensure timely and effective administration of postexposure prophylaxis. The internationally acquired human rabies case demonstrates that the US remains vulnerable to human and animal rabies importations. Clinical Relevance The NRSS plays a crucial role in protecting public and animal health by monitoring rabies trends in the US.

papers.title: Serological response to extralabel use of parenteral rabies vaccines in 28 mammalian species
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective To evaluate immunogenicity, persistence of antibodies, survival after challenge, and anamnestic response following extralabel parenteral rabies vaccination across mammalian species compared with benchmarks from on-label canine vaccination. Methods Mammals described in published studies of extralabel parenteral rabies vaccination. A structured literature review (1980 to 2025) identified studies reporting serologic or challenge outcomes after extralabel parenteral rabies vaccination. Extracted data included taxonomic family; vaccine type and schedule, timing of serum collection, antibody titers, survival after experimental challenge, and response to booster vaccination. Random-effects meta-analyses were conducted by family and overall. Pooled proportions were compared with the World Organisation for Animal Health benchmark of 88% survival and with canine benchmarks for primary seroconversion (88.1%), antibody levels 6 to 12 months after primary vaccination (72.9%), and booster response (96.8%). Results 32 articles describing 41 studies met inclusion criteria, representing 2,630 animals from 28 species in 17 families. After primary vaccination, 84.4 ± 4.1% achieved titers ≥ 0.5 IU/mL, with 14 of 16 families noninferior to the canine benchmark. At ≥ 6 months, 63.7 ± 10.6% maintained titers ≥ 0.5 IU/mL. Among 79 vaccinated animals challenged with rabies virus, 89.0 ± 9.8% survived. Booster vaccination produced adequate titers in 89.1 ± 8.0% of 275 animals, with reduced responses in the families Elephantidae and Ursidae. Conclusions Modern-day rabies vaccines generate strong antibody responses across diverse mammalian families, with nondomestic canids responding similarly to domestic dogs. Clinical Relevance These findings support recognizing extralabel vaccination as biologically protective and can inform public health and animal management policies.
papers.journal: Journal of the American Veterinary Medical Association

papers.title_zh: 28 种哺乳动物对肠外注射 狂犬病 疫苗 的标签外使用的血清学反应
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Objective To evaluate immunogenicity, persistence of antibodies, survival after challenge, and anamnestic response following extralabel parenteral rabies vaccination across mammalian species compared with benchmarks from on-label canine vaccination. Methods Mammals described in published studies of extralabel parenteral rabies vaccination. A structured literature review (1980 to 2025) identified studies reporting serologic or challenge outcomes after extralabel parenteral rabies vaccination. Extracted data included taxonomic family; vaccine type and schedule, timing of serum collection, antibody titers, survival after experimental challenge, and response to booster vaccination. Random-effects meta-analyses were conducted by family and overall. Pooled proportions were compared with the World Organisation for Animal Health benchmark of 88% survival and with canine benchmarks for primary seroconversion (88.1%), antibody levels 6 to 12 months after primary vaccination (72.9%), and booster response (96.8%). Results 32 articles describing 41 studies met inclusion criteria, representing 2,630 animals from 28 species in 17 families. After primary vaccination, 84.4 ± 4.1% achieved titers ≥ 0.5 IU/mL, with 14 of 16 families noninferior to the canine benchmark. At ≥ 6 months, 63.7 ± 10.6% maintained titers ≥ 0.5 IU/mL. Among 79 vaccinated animals challenged with rabies virus, 89.0 ± 9.8% survived. Booster vaccination produced adequate titers in 89.1 ± 8.0% of 275 animals, with reduced responses in the families Elephantidae and Ursidae. Conclusions Modern-day rabies vaccines generate strong antibody responses across diverse mammalian families, with nondomestic canids responding similarly to domestic dogs. Clinical Relevance These findings support recognizing extralabel vaccination as biologically protective and can inform public health and animal management policies.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 目的 与标签犬类 狂犬病 疫苗接种 的基准相比,评估哺乳动物物种中标签外注射 狂犬病 疫苗接种 的免疫原性、抗体持久性、攻击后存活率和记忆反应。方法 已发表的标签外注射 狂犬病 疫苗接种 研究中描述的哺乳动物。一项结构化文献综述(1980 年至 2025 年)确定了报告标签外注射 狂犬病 疫苗接种 后血清学或挑战结果的研究。提取的数据包括分类科;疫苗 类型和时间表、血清采集时间、抗体滴度、实验攻击后的存活率以及对加强剂 疫苗接种 的反应。按家庭和整体进行随机效应荟萃分析。汇总比例与世界动物健康组织 88% 存活率基准以及犬类初次血清转化基准 (88.1%)、初次 疫苗接种 后 6 至 12 个月的抗体水平 (72.9%) 和加强反应 (96.8%) 进行比较。结果 描述 41 项研究的 32 篇文章符合纳入标准,代表 17 个科 28 个物种的 2,630 只动物。初次 疫苗接种 后,84.4 ± 4.1% 的家系达到滴度 ≥ 0.5 IU/mL,其中 16 个家系中有 14 个家系不劣于犬类基准。≥ 6 个月时,63.7 ± 10.6% 的滴度维持≥ 0.5 IU/mL。在接受 狂犬病病毒 攻击的 79 只接种疫苗的动物中,89.0 ± 9.8% 存活。加强剂 疫苗接种 在 275 只动物中的 89.1 ± 8.0% 中产生了足够的滴度,但象科和熊科的反应有所降低。结论 现代 狂犬病 疫苗 在不同的哺乳动物家族中产生强烈的抗体反应,非家养犬科动物的反应与家养狗类似。临床相关性 这些发现支持将额外标签 疫苗接种 视为生物保护性的,并可为公共卫生和动物管理政策提供信息。

papers.title: Emergent Entropic Forces Drive Inverse and Reentrant Phase Transitions in Condensates of Intrinsically Disordered Proteins
papers.abstract: We present a phenomenological, mean-field model for condensates of intrinsically disordered proteins that describes inverse phase transitions and qualitatively predicts reentrant phase behavior as a function of salt concentration. The model is based on a matrix-based formulation of the Flory-Huggins free energy, in which the enthalpic interaction parameter and the protein valence, defined here as the number of effective "sticky patches", are treated as free parameters. Its central insight is that integrating out dynamics of fast-moving molecular species generates an effective entropic force that increases the free-energy barrier to mixing, even within a mean-field description. We account for this by linking Gaussian integration of co-solutes to the Schur complement of the matrix-based Flory-Huggins free energy. This provides a general thermodynamic framework illustrating how enthalpic interactions that increase the number of available microstates necessarily induce effective entropic forces. We demonstrate the expressiveness and predictive power of the model by qualitatively reproducing recent experimental observations on the rabies virus phosphoprotein.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a thermodynamic framework to explain inverse and reentrant phase transitions in condensates of intrinsically disordered proteins, particularly in the context of rabies virus phosphoprotein behavior.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research involved a mean-field model based on the Flory-Huggins free energy, focusing on rabies virus and its associated condensates, with specific attention to the rabies virus phosphoprotein.
analysis.methods: The model was constructed using a matrix-based formulation of the Flory-Huggins free energy, incorporating Gaussian integration of co-solutes and the Schur complement to account for effective entropic forces generated by integrating out fast-moving molecular species.
analysis.main_results: The model successfully qualitatively reproduced recent experimental observations on the rabies virus phosphoprotein, demonstrating its ability to predict reentrant phase behavior as a function of salt concentration.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted their findings as a general thermodynamic framework that explains how enthalpic interactions can induce effective entropic forces, offering a novel perspective on phase transitions in protein condensates.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insights into the behavior of rabies virus phosphoprotein condensates, which could inform future studies on viral protein interactions and their implications for viral replication and pathogenesis.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a mean-field description and abstract-level evidence, which may not capture all complexities of real-world systems, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a mean-field thermodynamic model to explain inverse and reentrant phase transitions in condensates of intrinsically disordered proteins, with a focus on rabies virus phosphoprotein. The model integrates out fast-moving molecular species to generate effective entropic forces, which are linked to the Schur complement of the matrix-based Flory-Huggins free energy. The authors demonstrate that enthalpic interactions increasing microstate availability can induce entropic forces, offering a novel framework for understanding protein condensate behavior. The results qualitatively reproduce recent experimental observations on rabies virus phosphoprotein, highlighting the model's predictive power. The study's abstract-level evidence and mean-field approach limit its generalizability, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment. These findings may inform future research on viral protein interactions and their role in replication and disease progression.

elements_zh.methods: 该模型是使用基于弗洛里-哈金斯自由能矩阵的公式构建的,结合了共溶质的高斯积分和 Schur 补集,以解释通过积分快速移动的分子种类而产生的有效熵力。
elements_zh.main_results: 该模型成功定性地再现了最近对 狂犬病病毒 磷蛋白的实验观察结果,证明了其预测重入相行为作为盐浓度函数的能力。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将他们的发现解释为一个通用的热力学框架,解释了焓相互作用如何诱导有效的熵力,为蛋白质凝聚物的相变提供了新的视角。

We account for this by linking Gaussian integration of co-solutes to the Schur complement of the matrix-based Flory-Huggins free energy. This provides a general thermodynamic framework illustrating how enthalpic interactions that increase the number of available microstates necessarily induce effective entropic forces. We demonstrate the expressiveness and predictive power of the model by qualitatively reproducing recent experimental observations on the rabies virus phosphoprotein.

papers.title: ระบบและกลไกทางสงคมของการปองกนโรคพษสนขบา ภายใตกรอบ One Health: การศกษาเชงคณภาพแบบหลายกรณ จงหวดศรสะเกษ
papers.abstract: Rabies remains a major public health challenge requiring coordinated multisectoral action and effective social mechanisms across the public health, veterinary, local government, and community sectors within the One Health framework. This study aimed to examine the systems and social mechanisms associated with rabies prevention within a One Health framework and to compare how these mechanisms operated across three community settings in Si Sa Ket Province, Thailand. A multiple-case qualitative design was employed. Study sites were purposively selected using epidemiological and rabies surveillance data from 2021 to 2025 and represented three community settings: rabies-free, rabies-controlled, and areas undergoing rabies control. Data were collected through in-depth interviews with 15 administrators and key actors involved in rabies prevention and control and through focus group discussions with 50 community stakeholders. Data were analyzed using inductive and deductive thematic approaches at both within-case and cross-case levels. The findings indicated that rabies-free communities were characterized by effective animal data systems, vaccine quality assurance and cold-chain management, systematic follow-up of unvaccinated animals, and community regulations that were implemented in practice. Rabies-controlled communities had operational systems and community networks but still experienced limitations in data continuity and the follow-up of certain animal populations. Communities undergoing rabies control continued to face constraints related to service accessibility, stray dog management, risk communication, and the management of environmental risk points. Cross-case analysis revealed that community-based rabies prevention was associated with the interaction among service systems, vaccine quality, information systems, animal management, environmental management, community regulations, and public trust in government services. The findings suggest that strengthening integrated information systems, vaccine quality assurance, comprehensive dog population management, and enforceable community regulations could support rabies prevention under a One Health framework and enhance the sustainability of community-based rabies prevention and control.

papers.full_text: Abstract Background Rabies is a neglected, deadly, but preventable zoonotic disease that disproportionally affects rural and resource-limited populations of Africa and Asia. Timely post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) can prevent rabies in exposed humans, if the treatment is available and people know where to seek it. Objectives To explore the constraints to effective bite-case management and rabies PEP provision in Malawi. Materials and methods Interviews and focus group discussions were conducted to explore perspectives of human health care providers, animal health officers, and dog-bite victims to map the pathways, barriers, and bottlenecks that shape rabies-PEP access in Malawi. Results We found that the PEP access pathway in Malawi is cumbersome, multi-step, and often lengthy, starting with a veterinary risk assessment and referral before PEP-treatment is provided. Training of service providers was poor, protocols were inconsistent and One Health coordination between sectors was limited. Other barriers included the unavailability of vaccines, insufficient funding, shortages of assistant veterinary officers, long distances to health facilities and a lack of community awareness. Conclusion Simplifying the pathway to PEP for bite victims may reduce rabies deaths in Malawi. This would require clear service pathways and protocols, trained staff, and sufficient resources across settings and sectors. Structured two‐way information sharing between the animal health and public health sectors, grounded in a One Health framework, could reduce delays, improve patient care and follow‐up, and support vaccine forecasting and procurement. This study highlights the PEP access pathway and intersectoral communication systems as actionable entry points for improving equitable and timely access to rabies PEP in Malawi. elements_zh.main_results: 马拉维的 PEP 获取途径被发现是繁琐、多步骤且通常冗长的,首先是兽医风险评估和转诊,然后再提供 PEP-治疗。服务提供者的培训很差,协议不一致,部门之间的“同一个健康”协调有限。其他障碍包括无法获得 疫苗、资金不足、助理兽医官员短缺、距医疗机构较远以及缺乏社区意识。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调需要简化咬伤受害者获得 PEP 的途径,以减少马拉维的 狂犬病 死亡。这需要明确的服务途径和协议、训练有素的工作人员以及跨环境和部门的充足资源。动物健康和公共卫生部门之间基于同一个健康框架的结构化双向信息共享可以减少延误,改善患者护理和随访,并支持 疫苗 预测和采购。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为马拉维的 监测、诊断、治疗 和 狂犬病 的预防提供信息。简化 PEP 获取途径和改善部门间沟通系统可以让人们更公平、更及时地获取 狂犬病 PEP,从而有可能减少 狂犬病 死亡。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 研究设计的局限性包括服务提供者培训不足、方案不一致以及 One Health 协调有限。由于研究的定性性质以及参与者选择可能存在偏差,证据强度中等。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore the constraints to effective bite-case management and rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) provision in Malawi. Rabies is a neglected, deadly, but preventable zoonotic disease that disproportionately affects rural and resource-limited populations in Africa and Asia.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study involved interviews and focus group discussions with human health care providers, animal health officers, and dog-bite victims to map the pathways, barriers, and bottlenecks that shape rabies-PEP access in Malawi. The study was conducted in Malawi and included participants from various sectors.
analysis_en.methods: Interviews and focus group discussions were conducted to explore perspectives on the PEP access pathway in Malawi. Participants were provided with written and oral information about the study and about confidentiality, including information about audio recording. Only those who consented to participate and signed a consent form were included.
analysis_en.main_results: The PEP access pathway in Malawi was found to be cumbersome, multi-step, and often lengthy, starting with a veterinary risk assessment and referral before PEP-treatment is provided. Training of service providers was poor, protocols were inconsistent, and One Health coordination between sectors was limited. Other barriers included the unavailability of vaccines, insufficient funding, shortages of assistant veterinary officers, long distances to health facilities, and a lack of community awareness.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights the need for simplifying the pathway to PEP for bite victims to reduce rabies deaths in Malawi. This would require clear service pathways and protocols, trained staff, and sufficient resources across settings and sectors. Structured two-way information sharing between the animal health and public health sectors, grounded in a One Health framework, could reduce delays, improve patient care and follow-up, and support vaccine forecasting and procurement.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform surveillance, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of rabies in Malawi. Simplifying the PEP access pathway and improving intersectoral communication systems could lead to more equitable and timely access to rabies PEP, potentially reducing rabies deaths.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study design limitations include poor training of service providers, inconsistent protocols, and limited One Health coordination. The evidence strength is moderate due to the qualitative nature of the study and the potential for bias in participant selection.

papers.title: Self-Amplifying RNA Vaccines After the First Approvals: Technology, Development Landscape, and Regulatory Science Considerations
papers.abstract: Self-amplifying RNA (saRNA) is a next-generation nucleic acid vaccine platform that enhances antigen expression through intracellular amplification of replicon RNA without producing infectious virions. saRNA constructs encode an alphavirus-derived replicase comprising nonstructural proteins nsP1–nsP4 and can elicit robust immune responses at low RNA doses. Replication intermediates may activate RIG-I, MDA5, and endosomal TLR3/7/8, contributing adjuvant-like activity. Kostaive (ARCT-154; zapomeran) became the first saRNA vaccine to receive full marketing approval in Japan in 2023, followed by authorization in the European Union in 2025 and the United Kingdom in 2026, demonstrating the platform’s clinical and regulatory feasibility. Development now extends beyond COVID-19 to seasonal and pandemic influenza, rabies, Crimean–Congo hemorrhagic fever, Nipah virus disease, and individualized cancer vaccines. However, the longer transcripts and additional replicase and subgenomic-promoter elements make in vitro transcription efficiency, full-length RNA content, double-stranded and truncated RNA impurities, lipid nanoparticle encapsulation, and potency testing particularly important. Regulatory assessment increasingly focuses on correct replicase and antigen expression, the magnitude and duration of self-amplification, biodistribution and persistence, and comparability. This review synthesizes the scientific basis, development landscape, manufacturing challenges, and regulatory science considerations of saRNA vaccines.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore the development and regulatory considerations of self-amplifying RNA (saRNA) vaccines, particularly in the context of rabies virus and rabies disease. The background highlights the potential of saRNA as a next-generation nucleic acid vaccine platform that enhances antigen expression through intracellular amplification of replicon RNA without producing infectious virions.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a review of the scientific basis, development landscape, manufacturing challenges, and regulatory science considerations of saRNA vaccines. It includes rabies virus, rabies infection, Rabies lyssavirus, Lyssavirus rabies, classical rabies virus, rabies encephalitis, human rabies, and animal rabies as the target entities.
analysis.methods: The methods section outlines the development of saRNA constructs that encode an alphavirus-derived replicase comprising nonstructural proteins nsP1–nsP4, which can elicit robust immune responses at low RNA doses. It also discusses the importance of in vitro transcription efficiency, full-length RNA content, double-stranded and truncated RNA impurities, lipid nanoparticle encapsulation, and potency testing.
analysis.main_results: The main results indicate that Kostaive (ARCT-154; zapomeran) became the first saRNA vaccine to receive full marketing approval in Japan in 2023, followed by authorization in the European Union in 2025 and the United Kingdom in 2026, demonstrating the platform’s clinical and regulatory feasibility.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the development of saRNA vaccines extends beyond the initial focus on COVID-19 to include seasonal and pandemic influenza, rabies, Crimean–Congo hemorrhagic fever, Nipah virus disease, and individualized cancer vaccines, highlighting the platform's versatility and potential for broader applications.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of saRNA vaccines for rabies and other diseases, emphasizing the importance of regulatory assessment and the need for further research into the platform's efficacy and safety for these applications.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a review of existing literature and does not include new experimental data. The evidence strength is moderate, as it relies on reported developments and regulatory approvals rather than original research findings.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the development and regulatory considerations of self-amplifying RNA (saRNA) vaccines, particularly for rabies virus and rabies disease. It outlines the scientific basis of saRNA vaccines, which enhance antigen expression through intracellular amplification without producing infectious virions. The study highlights the clinical and regulatory feasibility of saRNA vaccines, as demonstrated by the approval of Kostaive (ARCT-154; zapomeran) in Japan, the European Union, and the United Kingdom. It also discusses the platform's potential for use in various diseases, including rabies, seasonal influenza, and cancer vaccines. The review emphasizes the importance of in vitro transcription efficiency, RNA purity, and lipid nanoparticle encapsulation in vaccine development. However, the study is limited to a literature review and does not present original data, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

papers.title_zh: 首次批准后的自扩增 RNA 疫苗:技术、发展前景和监管科学考虑因素
papers.source_body_en: Self-amplifying RNA (saRNA) is a next-generation nucleic acid vaccine platform that enhances antigen expression through intracellular amplification of replicon RNA without producing infectious virions. saRNA constructs encode an alphavirus-derived replicase comprising nonstructural proteins nsP1–nsP4 and can elicit robust immune responses at low RNA doses. Replication intermediates may activate RIG-I, MDA5, and endosomal TLR3/7/8, contributing adjuvant-like activity. Kostaive (ARCT-154; zapomeran) became the first saRNA vaccine to receive full marketing approval in Japan in 2023, followed by authorization in the European Union in 2025 and the United Kingdom in 2026, demonstrating the platform’s clinical and regulatory feasibility. Development now extends beyond COVID-19 to seasonal and pandemic influenza, rabies, Crimean–Congo hemorrhagic fever, Nipah virus disease, and individualized cancer vaccines. However, the longer transcripts and additional replicase and subgenomic-promoter elements make in vitro transcription efficiency, full-length RNA content, double-stranded and truncated RNA impurities, lipid nanoparticle encapsulation, and potency testing particularly important. Regulatory assessment increasingly focuses on correct replicase and antigen expression, the magnitude and duration of self-amplification, biodistribution and persistence, and comparability. This review synthesizes the scientific basis, development landscape, manufacturing challenges, and regulatory science considerations of saRNA vaccines.

papers.title: Microbiological safety assessment of canine adipose derived mesenchymal stem cell preparations reveal no detectable contamination
papers.abstract: The experimental application of canine adipose-derived mesenchymal stem/stromal cells (cAD-MSC) has demonstrated excellent therapeutic potential in the treatment of a number of previously untreatable or difficult-to-treat diseases. However, the production of cAD-MSC for clinical application necessitates in vitro isolation and cell expansion, introducing the risk of microbiological contamination. Studies indicate that stored MSCs may be contaminated with bacteria, fungi, or viruses, resulting in cell transformation, cell death, or persistent infection. This ultimately compromises therapeutic efficacy and potentially facilitates therapy-induced pathogen transmission. In accordance with the European Medicines Agency guidelines mandating sterility testing as an integral component of the manufacturing process, this study aimed to assess the sterility of the cAD-MSC bank at the Croatian Veterinary Institute. To test for the most clinically significant canine pathogens, nucleic acids were extracted from 32 cAD-MSC preparations and analyzed using standard molecular PCR methods. The pathogen screening panel included rabies virus (Lyssavirus), canine herpesvirus (Varicellovirus canidalpha1), parvovirus (Carnivore protoparvovirus 1), coronavirus (Alphacoronavirus 1), distemper virus (Morbillivirus canis), Rotavirus A, Leptospira spp, Brucella canis, Borrelia burgdorferi sensu lato, Anaplasma spp, Ehrlichia spp, Mycoplasma spp (hemotropic), and Neospora caninum. No tested gene fragments of the aforementioned pathogens were detected, indicating that the cAD-MSC preparations were free from the presence of clinically significant pathogens. Rigorous implementation of sterility control during the cell isolation and expansion process is essential to ensure safe cell-based therapy in canine patients.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to assess the microbiological safety of canine adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cell (cAD-MSC) preparations, as their therapeutic application requires ensuring they are free from contamination that could compromise efficacy or pose risks to canine patients.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted at the Croatian Veterinary Institute, where 32 cAD-MSC preparations were tested for the presence of clinically significant pathogens, including rabies virus, using molecular PCR methods.
analysis.methods: Nucleic acids were extracted from the 32 cAD-MSC preparations and analyzed using standard molecular PCR methods to detect the presence of the specified pathogens, including rabies virus.
analysis.main_results: No gene fragments of rabies virus or any other tested pathogens were detected in the 32 cAD-MSC preparations, indicating they were free from contamination.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that the cAD-MSC preparations met sterility requirements, which is a novel confirmation of their safety for therapeutic use in canine patients.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide critical information for ensuring the safety of cell-based therapies in veterinary medicine, particularly for rabies virus, which is a significant public health concern in canine populations.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to testing a specific set of pathogens, and the absence of contamination in the tested samples does not guarantee complete safety, though the evidence is strong given the rigorous testing protocol.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the microbiological safety of canine adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cell (cAD-MSC) preparations by testing them for contamination with rabies virus and other pathogens. The research was motivated by the need to ensure the safety of these cells for therapeutic use, as their production involves in vitro isolation and expansion, which can introduce contamination risks. Using molecular PCR methods, 32 cAD-MSC samples were analyzed, and no gene fragments of rabies virus or other tested pathogens were detected, indicating the preparations were free from contamination. The findings suggest that the cAD-MSC preparations met sterility requirements, which is a novel confirmation of their safety for therapeutic use in canine patients. The study's results have important implications for veterinary medicine, particularly in ensuring the safety of cell-based therapies. However, the study is limited to testing a specific set of pathogens, and the absence of contamination in the tested samples does not guarantee complete safety, though the evidence is strong given the rigorous testing protocol.

papers.title_zh: 犬脂肪间充质干细胞制剂的微生物安全评估显示没有可检测到的污染
papers.source_body_en: The experimental application of canine adipose-derived mesenchymal stem/stromal cells (cAD-MSC) has demonstrated excellent therapeutic potential in the treatment of a number of previously untreatable or difficult-to-treat diseases. However, the production of cAD-MSC for clinical application necessitates in vitro isolation and cell expansion, introducing the risk of microbiological contamination. Studies indicate that stored MSCs may be contaminated with bacteria, fungi, or viruses, resulting in cell transformation, cell death, or persistent infection. This ultimately compromises therapeutic efficacy and potentially facilitates therapy-induced pathogen transmission. In accordance with the European Medicines Agency guidelines mandating sterility testing as an integral component of the manufacturing process, this study aimed to assess the sterility of the cAD-MSC bank at the Croatian Veterinary Institute. To test for the most clinically significant canine pathogens, nucleic acids were extracted from 32 cAD-MSC preparations and analyzed using standard molecular PCR methods. The pathogen screening panel included rabies virus (Lyssavirus), canine herpesvirus (Varicellovirus canidalpha1), parvovirus (Carnivore protoparvovirus 1), coronavirus (Alphacoronavirus 1), distemper virus (Morbillivirus canis), Rotavirus A, Leptospira spp, Brucella canis, Borrelia burgdorferi sensu lato, Anaplasma spp, Ehrlichia spp, Mycoplasma spp (hemotropic), and Neospora caninum. No tested gene fragments of the aforementioned pathogens were detected, indicating that the cAD-MSC preparations were free from the presence of clinically significant pathogens. Rigorous implementation of sterility control during the cell isolation and expansion process is essential to ensure safe cell-based therapy in canine patients.
papers.abstract_zh: 犬脂肪源性间充质干细胞/基质细胞(cAD-MSC)的实验应用已证明治疗对许多以前无法治疗或难以治疗的疾病具有优异的治疗潜力。然而,用于临床应用的cAD-MSC的生产需要体外分离和细胞扩增,从而引入微生物污染的风险。研究表明,储存的间充质干细胞可能被细菌、真菌或病毒污染,导致细胞转化、细胞死亡或持续感染。这最终会损害治疗效果并可能促进治疗诱导的病原体 传播。根据欧洲药品管理局指南,要求将无菌检测作为生产过程的一个组成部分,本研究旨在评估克罗地亚兽医研究所 cAD-MSC 库的无菌性。为了检测临床上最重要的犬病原体,从 32 个 cAD-MSC 制剂中提取核酸,并使用标准分子 PCR 方法进行分析。病原体筛查小组包括狂犬病病毒(狂犬病毒)、犬疱疹病毒(Varicellovirus canidalpha1)、细小病毒(Carnivore protoparvovirus 1)、冠状病毒(Alphacoronavirus 1)、犬瘟热病毒(Morbillivirus canis)、轮状病毒A、钩端螺旋体属、犬布鲁氏菌、伯氏疏螺旋体、无形体spp、埃利希体属、支原体属(嗜血性)和犬新孢子虫。没有检测到上述病原体的测试基因片段,表明cAD-MSC制剂不存在临床上显着的病原体。在细胞分离和扩增过程中严格实施无菌控制对于确保犬类患者的安全细胞治疗至关重要。

papers.title: Impact of the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake on domestic dogs: An SCM analysis of three disaster-affected prefectures
papers.abstract: Natural disasters affect not only physical infrastructure and human lives but also various aspects of our daily lives. Previous studies reported that disasters led people to develop more positive or more negative attitudes toward domestic animals. Most of this literature, however, compares pre- and post-disaster outcomes; the appropriate comparison should be conducted between the observed post-disaster reality and the counterfactual scenario in which the disaster did not occur. To address this gap arising from constraints in the practical application, this study applied the Synthetic Control Method (SCM) to examine the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake as an example. Iwate, Miyagi, and Fukushima Prefectures were regarded as the treated units, and synthetic trajectories were constructed for Prefecture-level data on (1) Registered dogs, (2) Rabies shots, (3) Stray dogs captured, and (4) Rehomed dogs. By comparing the actual and synthetic trajectories, we evaluated long-term changes in observable indicators related to domestic animals. To further understand these long-term tendencies, the Animal Welfare Kuznets (AWK) curves were estimated using a fixed-effects model. The results indicated the presence of an AWK curve and suggested that Japan is currently in a phase where conditions of domestic animals improve as income rises. Our results showed that, among the four indicators across the three treated prefectures, the actual trajectories for rehomed dogs in Miyagi and Fukushima showed substantial divergence from synthetic trajectories, although subsequent sensitivity analyses provided more consistent support for the Fukushima case. Taken together with the AWK curve results, these findings may suggest that some disaster-separated dogs were actively sought and recovered after the disaster.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the impact of the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake on domestic dogs using the Synthetic Control Method (SCM). It addresses the gap in literature that typically compares pre- and post-disaster outcomes by analyzing the divergence between actual and synthetic trajectories for rehomed dogs in three affected prefectures. To address this gap arising from constraints in the practical application, this study applied the Synthetic Control Method (SCM) to examine the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake as an example. Iwate, Miyagi, and Fukushima Prefectures were regarded as the treated units, and synthetic trajectories were constructed for Prefecture-level data on (1) Registered dogs, (2) Rabies shots, (3) Stray dogs captured, and (4) Rehomed dogs. By comparing the actual and synthetic trajectories, we evaluated long-term changes in observable indicators related to domestic animals. To further understand these long-term tendencies, the Animal Welfare Kuznets (AWK) curves were estimated using a fixed-effects model. The results indicated the presence of an AWK curve and suggested that Japan is currently in a phase where conditions of domestic animals improve as income rises. Our results showed that, among the four indicators across the three treated prefectures, the actual trajectories for rehomed dogs in Miyagi and Fukushima showed substantial divergence from synthetic trajectories, although subsequent sensitivity analyses provided more consistent support for the Fukushima case. Taken together with the AWK curve results, these findings may suggest that some disaster-separated dogs were actively sought and recovered after the disaster.

Here's what to know about the virus There is no treatment for animals with rabies. Nicole Ireland, The Canadian Press Oct 23, 2026 1:50 PM Share by Email Share on Facebook Share on X Share on LinkedIn Print Share via Text Message A raccoon is seen in an environment reproducing a Laurentian Maple Forrest during a media event at Montreal's Biodome on Thursday, August 20, 2020. THE CANADIAN PRESS/Paul Chiasson Listen to this article 00:05:05 TORONTO — Public health officials in B.C. and Quebec are dealing with rabies in wild animals that have come into contact with people or domestic pets. In Vancouver, it was a single skunk but in parts of Quebec, there is an outbreak of rabies in raccoons that has transmitted the virus to three cats. On Friday, the Canadian Food Inspection Agency (CFIA), which is responsible for national rabies surveillance, said that the number of animal cases fluctuates from year to year, but preliminary data suggests "increased rabies activity in raccoons, particularly in Quebec, is a major factor contributing to the higher number of confirmed rabies cases reported this year." Between January and September of this year, 397 laboratory-confirmed rabies cases in animals were reported to the CFIA. In 2025, there were 281 cases in the entire year. Public health officials emphasize that rabies infections in humans are still "extremely rare." Here's what you need to know. What is rabies? Rabies is a viral infection that affects the nervous system, including the brain. In Canada, rabies infections in humans are rare, but almost always fatal if it's not treated before symptoms develop. The virus infects the nerves around the site where it entered the body and then makes its way into the spinal cord and brain, ultimately leading to death. How is it transmitted? Rabies is transmitted to humans when they are bitten or scratched by an infected animal. Saliva is the most common source of transmission. In Canada, wild animals such as bats, skunks, raccoons and foxes are the main carriers of rabies, but they can transmit it to pets such as cats or dogs and farm animals. Bats are the primary carriers of rabies in Canada. Experts urge people to see a health-care provider if they've had suspected contact with any bat because their bites or scratches are tiny and might go unnoticed. People should also seek medical attention immediately if they have come into contact with other animals that may have rabies. On Wednesday, Vancouver Coastal Health issued a news bulletin about a skunk with rabies that had bitten a "small" number of people in Vancouver. Those people were treated and the health authority urged anyone who may have been bitten or scratched by a skunk in the city's West End neighbourhood between Sept. 22 and Oct. 17 to contact them. The government of Quebec has reported an outbreak of rabies in raccoons and is continuing to do surveillance. Its latest count available online is 313 confirmed raccoons with rabies in the province since the beginning of the year. Three cats have been infected through raccoons. What is the treatment? There is no treatment for animals with rabies. The only way for the infection to be confirmed in animals is to examine the brain after death. Humans must receive treatment before symptoms appear, which usually happens about three to eight weeks after exposure, according to the Public Health Agency of Canada. People should thoroughly wash the area where they were bitten or scratched with soap and water and seek medical attention immediately. The treatment is a series of vaccines and an immunoglobulin injection. The first rabies vaccine shot is given immediately, followed by shots on days three, seven and 14. The immunoglobulin injection, a ready-made antibody that starts fighting the virus right away, is also administered because it takes time for the body to mount an immune response from the vaccinations. Side effects of the vaccine are usually mild and temporary. They can include fever, chills, sweats and feeling unwell. What are some ways to protect people and pets? The Wildlife Rescue Association of BC said in a news release on Friday that the most effective prevention strategy for people is to "avoid direct physical contact with wildlife, particularly animals that appear sick, injured, unusually aggressive, lethargic, or disoriented." The association also urged people to make sure their pets are up to date on their rabies vaccinations and to "keep them leashed and supervised outdoors to help prevent contact with wildlife." How common is rabies death in humans? There have been 28 deaths from rabies in humans reported since 1924. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Oct. 23, 2026. news.content_title: Feral cat in Nassau found to have rabies, the second case of the disease in the county this year
news.content: A trapped feral cat in East Meadow. Credit: Barry Sloan By Lisa L. Colangelo lisa.colangelo@newsday.com @lisalcolangelo Updated October 23, 2026 9:21 pm A feral cat found in South Hempstead has tested positive for rabies, Nassau County Health Department officials said Friday. This is only the second case of terrestrial rabies this year in Nassau County after a surge in wildlife rabies cases in 2025. That year, 26 raccoons and one stray cat tested positive for the dangerous virus. Bats, who also carry the virus, are not counted in terrestrial rabies cases. The cases appear to have moved west into Suffolk County where rabies has been found in 50 raccoons and two cats since February 2025. Rabies is a potentially deadly virus transmitted through the saliva of an infected animal. That transfer can happen through a bite or the infected saliva getting into an open wound, eyes, nose or mouth, according to the state Health Department. "The decline in confirmed rabies cases this year is encouraging and reflects the success of our ongoing rabies control efforts," Nassau County Commissioner of Health Dr. Irina Gelman said in a statement. "However, this latest case serves as an important reminder that rabies is still present in Nassau County. We urge residents to avoid contact with wild and feral animals and make sure their pets are up to date on rabies vaccinations." Even though the rabies cases are primarily in wild animals, they can encounter domestic animals and potentially spread the virus. Stray cats and raccoons often share food and water at feeding stations maintained by caretakers. During two recent incidents in Suffolk County, pet dogs came into contact with raccoons on their property that later tested positive for rabies. Both dogs were previously vaccinated. This fall, both Nassau and Suffolk counties conducted rabies bait vaccination programs , where more than 300,000 packets of the vaccine were distributed in areas where raccoons frequent. Smothered in fish oil and scales, raccoons ingest the liquid vaccine when they bite into the packets. Anyone who is bitten or scratched by an animal in Nassau County should seek medical attention and then contact the Health Department at (516) 227-9663 or (516) 742-6154 after hours and on weekends. By Lisa L. Colangelo lisa.colangelo@newsday.com @lisalcolangelo Lisa joined Newsday as a staff writer in 2019. She previously worked at amNewYork, the New York Daily News and the Asbury Park Press covering politics, government and general assignment. Officials urge residents to avoid contact with wild and feral animals and ensure their pets are vaccinated. The virus is transmitted through saliva, typically via bites or contact with open wounds, eyes, nose, or mouth. Anyone bitten or scratched should seek medical attention and contact the Health Department for further guidance.
